rows.grounds: back side; accusative object of vihāya
absolutive of vi-hā, having left or abandoned
optative of bhū, may be or should be

items.question: When arranging the selected deities, should the back triad be abandoned so that one remains in front, or may another arrangement obtain?
items.inference: The verse prescribes leaving three rear items and placing one forward, with an optional alternative.
uncertainties: exact referent of triad not explicit in this verse
whether bhavet is prescriptive or permissive
items.plain_english: Leaving the back triad, one [is placed] in front, or it may be [otherwise].
